traffic_profile: Early-stage ecommerce seasonal bursts. Baseline API calls ~5k/day, expected growth to 20k/day in 6 weeks. Campaigns produce short spikes: 500-2,000 rps sustained for 30-120s; occasional scheduled big launches (~5,000 rps) for <10s. Typical request size small: 64-256 tokens.
latency_and_throughput_targets: P95 generation latency <500ms for requests <512 tokens; tolerate up to 1s during large spikes. Target steady concurrency ~50, burst concurrency allowance to 300 with controlled fallback.
rate_limit_requirements: Needs per-API-key concurrency limits, clear 429 semantics, graceful retry headers (Retry-After), and webhook/alert when soft quota exceeded. Wants optional burst credit to allow short campaign spikes without manual quota bumps.
retry_and_backoff_expectations: Client to implement exponential backoff on 429/503. Request Redwood guidance: recommended initial backoff 500ms, max backoff 30s, jitter. Wants a small example code snippet in onboarding docs.
quota_and_pricing_concerns: Prefers predictable monthly cap with overage protection (soft limit + auto-bump / charge) rather than abrupt cutoff. Price sensitivity: wants estimates of per-1k-token cost at 90th percentile traffic.
fallback_and_degradation_policy: Would like server-side fallbacks: lower-cost model variant if capacity constrained, and deterministic 429 policy instead of silent failures. Wants ability to opt into degraded mode (summaries only) during outages.
poa_for_technical_eval: SE to provision sandbox API key with tuned quota and simulate two campaign spikes. Run canary: 3x 120s bursts at expected rps with monitoring. Capture 429 counts, latency tail, and recommended autoscaling/burst config.
